product_name: Bajaj Life Group Accidental Permanent Total/Partial Disability Benefit Rider
regulatory_descriptor: A Non-Participating, Non-Linked Group Health Rider (to be attached to a base group plan)
key_benefits: Group health rider attached to a base group plan, covering members for Accidental Permanent Total or Partial Disability.
Permanent Partial Disability: lower of 50% of rider sum assured or Rs 50,00,000 per member across all Bajaj group policies.
Permanent Total Disability: lower of the rider sum assured or Rs 1,00,00,000 per member across all Bajaj group policies.
Disability must occur within 180 days of the accident and persist continuously for at least 180 days; defined dismemberment/loss schedule applies.
Option to take the disability benefit in equal monthly installments over 5 years (factor 1.04) or 10 years (factor 1.08).
No death benefit, no maturity benefit, no surrender benefit under the rider.

eligibility.max_benefit_total_disability: Rs 1,00,00,000 per member across all Bajaj group policies
eligibility.max_benefit_partial_disability: Rs 50,00,000 per member across all Bajaj group policies
eligibility.policy_term: As per the base group plan (rider terminates at membership anniversary on which attained age is 65)
eligibility.note: Numeric entry-age and rider sum-assured ranges are not captured in the parse; benefit caps above are stated explicitly in the brochure. Verify other limits against the policy document.

key_terms.free_look_note: As per the base policy, applicable from the Date of Commencement of Rider if different from the base Date of Commencement of Risk.
key_terms.grace_period: As per the base policy; disability occurring during grace is payable subject to deduction of due-but-unpaid rider premium.
key_terms.suicide_clause: Not applicable (no death benefit); intentional self-inflicted injury / attempted suicide is an excluded cause of disability.
key_terms.surrender_value: No surrender benefit under the rider.
key_terms.tax_note: Tax benefits 'as per applicable tax laws' — consult a tax consultant; GST per prevailing tax laws.

mandatory_disclosures_present: Exclusions ('What is not covered under this rider')

claims_marketing_must_support: This is a rider attached to a base group plan — it cannot be marketed as a standalone policy; any claim must reference the base group plan.
Disability benefit is the LOWER of the rider sum assured and a per-member cap (Rs 50 lakh partial / Rs 1 crore total across all Bajaj group policies) — must not be presented as an uncapped payout.

'Accidental Permanent Total/Partial Disability' is defined by a specific dismemberment/loss schedule with a 180-day occurrence and 180-day persistence requirement — claims must reflect these conditions, not generic 'any disability'.
Installment payout factors (1.04 over 5 yrs / 1.08 over 10 yrs) are subject to periodic IRDAI-approved revision.
claims_marketing_must_avoid: Do NOT present as a savings/investment or maturity product — there is no maturity, surrender or death benefit.
Do NOT use 'guaranteed returns' / 'bonus' / 'money back' language.

Do NOT imply any disability is covered — only the listed permanent total/partial dismemberment events qualify, and a long list of exclusions (criminal acts, war, intoxication, hazardous sports, aviation, self-injury, nuclear) applies.
Do NOT omit the per-member benefit caps across all Bajaj group policies.
Tax benefits must not be stated as assured — always carry the 'as per applicable tax laws' caveat.
must_state: Full regulatory descriptor: 'A Non-Participating, Non-Linked Group Health Rider' attached to a base group plan
That it is a rider (not a standalone plan) with no death/maturity/surrender benefit.
Standard disclaimer to read the policy document / benefit illustration for full conditions and exclusions.

gaps: Parser NAME was generic 'Bajaj Life'; real product name inferred from the brochure heading and body.
